mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_SWORD + i from Sword{i+1}; _enum.h names MODEL_LIGHTING_SWORD = MODEL_SWORD + 14, and mu.db agrees: group 0 index 14, Item/Sword15.bmd.
why_this_one: Devias's merchants (Izabel, Zienna in src/sim/market.cpp) list the Lighting Sword, and the shelf dropped the line for want of a cooked mesh.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Weapons.cs. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: WeaponInitializerBase.CreateWeapon(group, number, slot, skillNumber, width, height, dropsFromMonsters, name, dropLevel, minimumDamage, maximumDamage, attackSpeed, durability, magicPower, levelRequirement, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, energyRequirement, vitalityRequirement, wizardClass, knightClass, elfClass).

stance_from: MuWeapons.cs (the old client's table, LEGACY history 085a8169^:godot/Assets/Items/MuWeapons.cs): WeaponStance.Sword, TwoHanded: false.
sheet_from: Data/Item/sword15.OZJ (64x64) and sword15_2.OZJ (64x64), from MuMain at c0d74c4. The .bmd names sword15.jpg on 80 triangles and sword15_2.jpg on 8.
sheet_note: sword15 is the sword: a white-and-blue banded steel blade on the left, a bronze-and-gold ornate guard on the right. sword15_2 is blue lightning on black - MU's added mesh, so the black is nothing and the bolts are light.
glow_note: MU's ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5304): `case MODEL_LIGHTING_SWORD: BlendMesh = 1; BlendMeshTexCoordU = (rand()%10)*0.1; BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3 + 0.7` - sword15_2's lightning drawn added, breathing, and jumping along U. The glow's jitter moves U and V together here; MU moves U alone.
material_note: Islands 0 to 2 on sword15: the blade and its ornate guard share island 0 (62 triangles, mean (130, 118, 100)), and islands 1 and 2 are the grey grip (69, 70, 79). Steel on all, at 0.45 as the Legendary Sword was passed, so the flat blade does not mirror the grass or go black. The bronze guard lies inside the blade island and cannot take brass. Islands 3 to 6 are sword15_2, the glow.
